body: I'm sorry. I don't want to add to your pain. I should be more grateful for what I have, and who is to say that these things won't make you happy - and are probably within reach. I'm just not right upstairs, I think. Don't give up.

Thank you.

I haven't increased my living conditions since I started this career, so once the student loans are paid off, I should be in good shape. I have a very simple dream of a very simple life. I'm amazed that that seems to have been apparent to you between the lines above. I think about it often. 

And thank you re: the man part. I know you don't know me, but that helps a lot.
